name: Hymnal
description: A manuscript editor for planning, writing and editing Leanpub / Markua books

install.firstRun: Open a folder with a Book.txt, or an empty folder to start a new book, from File > Open Workspace.
install.uninstallNote: Your manuscripts were not touched. Hymnal's settings stay in your app-data folder (Hymnal/settings.json) and its update downloads in ~/.hymnal; delete them if you like.
